description: Paid (25.00 USDC per season); free alternatives: get_track_record for pick results. For backtesting a season of Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2 forecasts against results. One season of tactica.'s forecasts against results: every finished league match we forecast, with fixtureId, league, kick-off, teams, our last forecast before kick-off (chances, expected goals, model version, generated time) and the final score. Use this when you want to test or evaluate a model or strategy against our history; it may not be used to train any model or AI system. Use get_track_record instead (free) for pick results. A season without pre-match forecasts says so. Read-only.

season.description: Required. The season, four-digit start year, a hyphen and two-digit end year. Only seasons with genuine published pre-match forecasts are sold. Example: 2026-27
